Send a LS to RAN2 to inform them of the configuration parameters that were introduced in CR1075 and ask them to introduce the following independent UE capabilities for SRS antenna switching per BoBC: Support of SRS-Antenna-Switching-1T4R: Indicates the UE supports 1T4R in the corresponding band of combination. Support of SRS-Antenna-Switching-2T4R with SRS-Antenna-Switching-2T4R-NrofPairs = 2: Indicates the UE supports 2T4R with two antenna pairs (Λ=2 in TS 36.213, Clause 8.2) for the corresponding band of band combination. Support of SRS-Antenna-Switching-2T4R with SRS-Antenna-Switching-2T4R-NrofPairs = 3: Indicates the UE supports 2T4R with three antenna pairs (Λ=3 in TS 36.213, Clause 8.2) for the corresponding band of band combination. R1-1807505Draft LS on parameters and capabilities
